says: Pressing Enter in the loaded definition files list opens the selected file's details only when a row is selected. Double-clicking has no such check, so double-clicking empty space fails.
Pressing Enter in the support definitions list opens the selected definition's details only when a row is selected. Double-clicking has no such check, so double-clicking empty space fails.
Double-clicking, or pressing Enter, on any of the three product lists opens the selected product's details, and does nothing when no product is selected.
